social_circle.name: Mai Tran

demographics.education: Some high school in Vietnam; no college degree

background.how_they_met: Mai is Chol's mother and raised her in a Vietnamese American household in Portland after immigrating from Vietnam in the late 1990s.
background.why_close: They live together, share household responsibilities, and Mai remains Chol's main family check-in person. Chol helps her with bills, appointments, medical portals, and English-language paperwork.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts short practical questions, often about food, safety, appointments, or whether Chol got home. Uses direct wording, occasional Vietnamese phrases, and few emojis.

recent_text_topics: Checking whether Chol got home safely after night shifts.
Appointment reminders and medical portal questions for Mai or Chol's father.
What food is already cooked at home so Chol does not buy takeout after work.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 says Chol's parents are central to family life and that she texts her mom after night shifts so she knows Chol is okay. Q11 says Chol lives with her mom, dad, and younger brother. Q35 says Chol helps schedule appointments and translate medical language. Q103 describes her mother's food service and production or packaging work.

social_circle.name: Linh Nguyen

demographics.occupation: community college student and part-time restaurant server
demographics.education: High school diploma; currently taking community college classes

background.how_they_met: Linh is one of Chol's local cousins in the Portland Vietnamese community, part of the extended family network Chol grew up around.
background.why_close: They are close in age, share family history, play basketball together, get food after activities, and are part of each other's everyday support system.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Fast texter with slang, reaction emojis, screenshots, and teasing. She sends short bursts of messages rather than polished paragraphs.

shared_activities: helping bridge younger and older family perspectives
recent_text_topics: Planning basketball runs around Chol's correctional officer shifts.
Deciding where to get pho, tacos, boba, or banh mi after playing.
Talking through family stress, dating, and Chol's GED pressure.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q07 explicitly names Linh as one of the people Chol spends the most free time with: 'Linh is my basketball and food person.' Q49 says Chol directly texts Linh for emotional support. Q05 says Chol is close with cousins around her age who play basketball, eat late-night pho, and talk about work or relationships.

social_circle.name: Malia Thompson

demographics.education: High school diploma; some college coursework

background.how_they_met: Malia became close to Chol through Portland's climbing and active friend circles.
background.why_close: Malia helps Chol keep work from becoming her whole identity, climbs with her, talks honestly about politics and stress, and challenges Chol without turning conversations into arguments.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Uses casual but thoughtful texts, voice notes when a topic is emotional, and lots of Instagram links for climbing clips, food, concerts, and travel ideas.

recent_text_topics: Coordinating climbing sessions and checking Chol's shifting schedule.
Saving Lisbon food spots, neighborhoods, and budget tips in shared travel apps.
Talking about race, policing, and how Chol feels about working in corrections.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q07 names Malia as one of the two people Chol spends the most free time with and says Malia climbs with her. Q29 says Malia is the friend Chol discusses race and policing with most honestly. Q49 says Chol directly texts Malia when she is actually struggling.

social_circle.name: Bao Tran

background.how_they_met: Bao is Chol's younger brother and has lived with her throughout their family life in Portland.
background.why_close: They live in the same household, joke around, run errands, share food routines, and Chol feels responsible for helping him avoid the academic mistakes she regrets.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts short messages, memes, and practical requests. More likely to send 'can you pick me up?' than a long emotional message.

recent_text_topics: Rides, errands, and whether Chol can pick something up on the way home.
School planning and Chol reminding him not to fall behind.
Jokes, memes, and food requests from the household.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 says Chol has a younger brother still in school and feels responsible for setting a better academic example for him. Q05 follow-up says they mostly do food, errands, and joking around, and that she sometimes helps him with school planning. Q51 confirms he lives with Chol.

social_circle.name: Serena Park

demographics.education: High school diploma; corrections academy and workplace training

background.how_they_met: Serena met Chol at the corrections workplace and became one of the few coworkers Chol trusts beyond routine professional interaction.
background.why_close: Serena is calm, discreet, and experienced. Chol turns to her after tense incidents because Serena understands the job without gossiping or making Chol feel weak.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts in clear, steady sentences with few emojis. Often sends practical advice, reminders to sleep, or a short 'call me if you need to vent.'

shared_activities: advice about reports and workplace confidence
recent_text_topics: Chol replaying a tense verbal escalation and asking whether she handled it correctly.
How to write clear reports without obsessing over every detail afterward.
Encouragement about GED study and not letting work consume her whole identity.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q44 says Chol talked to 'a senior officer who is calm and does not gossip' after a rough work incident. Q49 says one coworker she trusts is among the people she directly texts when actually struggling. Q77 says Chol has a few coworkers she trusts while keeping boundaries.
